split-card.looks: A large card split in two: a photo filling one half; a heading, a paragraph and one or two buttons on the other half.
split-card.use: Introducing one programme, service or idea with a photo; the site's most common feature card. Several in a row make an alternating feature list (flip imagePosition each time).
split-card.avoid: No photo: use Section Title, or Custom Text with a Custom Btn Icon.

fields.subheading: The paragraph. Rich text; a link inside a sentence stays a text link.
fields.buttonSubtext: Optional small line under the button.
fields.imagePosition: left or right. Alternate it when stacking several split cards.
fields.imageSize: even (half and half) or smaller (narrower photo).
